title: 第27章 血肉之躯第28章 新的挑战
lines: 冰冷从心脏蔓延。
每一次搏动，都像万年寒冰在胸腔碎裂，尖锐的冰棱刺穿血肉。
混乱的低语在意识边缘萦绕，诱惑着沉沦。
卡拉斯猛地睁眼。
映入眼帘的是深邃无垠的宇宙虚空，冰冷星辰点缀其间。
他悬浮其中，感受着失重带来的心悸。
身体是真实的血肉之躯，心脏沉重痛苦地跳动，每一次搏动都牵引着胸口嵌入的混沌结晶。
那结晶冰冷地吮吸着他的生命力，将混乱毒素注入血液。
剧痛几乎让他再次昏厥。
他咬紧牙关，铁锈味在口中弥漫，强迫自己转动僵硬的脖颈。
巨大的幽绿星纹龙翼如破碎夜幕将他严密包裹。
暗爪蜷缩着身躯，头颅搁在前爪上，龙睛紧闭，呼吸微弱。
它鳞片上的星纹黯淡，多处焦黑翻卷，显然在脱离归墟时承受了巨大冲击。
曾经需要庇护的幼龙，如今成了他的壁垒。
愧疚、感激与更深沉的羁绊压过了剧痛。
卡拉斯颤抖地抬手，轻触暗爪一片完好的星纹鳞片。
触感冰凉坚韧，带着微弱的能量脉动。
就在这时，胸口的混沌结晶骤然加剧搏动！
混乱低语瞬间放大，如亿万毒虫在脑中嘶鸣！
冰冷侵蚀感涌向四肢百骸，试图将他拖回深渊！
“滚出去！”
卡拉斯在心中咆哮。
索兰尼亚骑士的钢铁意志在剧痛中爆发！
他将精神力凝聚成无形锋刃，狠狠斩向侵入脑域的混乱低语！
意识层面的无声厮杀激烈展开。
每一次意志斩击都消耗着他本已不多的精力，带来灵魂撕裂般的痛楚，但混沌侵蚀的浪潮被暂时遏制。
他的意志如暴风雨中的礁石，摇摇欲坠却始终屹立。
就在意志对抗达到白热化时，异变发生！
触碰暗爪鳞片的手指突然感受到一股微弱而清晰的脉动——源自这片虚空！
那感觉带着难以言喻的冰冷“情绪”
：悲伤？渴望？指引？这转瞬即逝的共鸣如清泉浇熄了部分狂躁。
卡拉斯猛地一怔，立即集中精神捕捉那奇异共鸣。
content_en:
Coldness spreads from the heart.
Every pulse was like ice cracking in the chest, with sharp ice edges piercing the flesh.
Chaotic whispers linger at the edges of consciousness, tempting you to sink.
Karas's eyes shot open.
What comes into view is the deep and boundless void of the universe, dotted with cold stars.
He was suspended in it, feeling the palpitations caused by weightlessness.
The body is made of real flesh and blood, and the heart beats heavily and painfully. Every beat pulls the chaotic crystal embedded in the chest.
The crystal sucked his life force coldly, injecting chaotic poison into his blood.
"Uh..."
The pain almost made him faint again.
He gritted his teeth, the taste of rust filling his mouth, and forced himself to turn his stiff neck.
Huge green star-patterned dragon wings wrapped him tightly like a broken night.
Darkpaw curled up with its head resting on its front paws, its eyes closed tightly and its breathing weak.
The star pattern on its scales was dim, and many places were charred and rolled. It was obvious that it had suffered a huge impact when it left the ruins.
The young dragon who once needed shelter now became his barrier.
Guilt, gratitude and a deeper bond overcame the pain.
Karas raised his hand tremblingly and lightly touched an intact star-patterned scale of Dark Claw.
It feels cold and tough to the touch, pulsing with faint energy.
At this moment, the chaos crystal in the chest suddenly intensified its pulsation!
The chaotic whispers amplified instantly, like billions of poisonous insects neighing in the brain!
A feeling of cold erosion rushed to his limbs and bones, trying to drag him back into the abyss!
"Get out!"
Karas roared in his mind.
The iron will of the Solamnian knights exploded in severe pain!
He condensed his mental power into an invisible blade and slashed hard at the chaotic whispers that invaded his brain!
The silent fighting at the level of consciousness rages on.
Each slash of will consumes his already limited energy and brings pain like soul tearing, but the wave of chaos erosion is temporarily contained.
His will is like a rock in a storm, crumbling but always standing.
Just when the confrontation of wills reaches fever pitch, a mutation occurs!
The fingers that touched the scales of the Dark Claw suddenly felt a weak but clear pulse - originating from this void!
That feeling carries an indescribable cold "emotion"
:Sad? eager? Guidance? This fleeting resonance is like a clear spring that quenches some of the mania.
Karas was startled suddenly and immediately concentrated on capturing the strange resonance.
